title: rabdosia umbrosa var. excisinflexa
intro: Rabdosia umbrosa var. excisinflexa, commonly known as Tibetan Club Moss, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tibetan Club Moss include calming the mind, relieving stress and anxiety, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diterpenoid quinones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
